name: Ker Plunk
doc: Jumbo Cactuar's Ker Plunk (enemy attack 231, c0m084, on the party): at a point in front of the caster growing rings, rising dust, debris thrown up, a white screen flash; each target lifted, spun and put down with a ring growing up at it, dust bursting out where it lands, its damage; a looping voice and two sounds. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag321_ker_plunk.cpp) run on the program's memory (its queues, particles and packet arenas in the module's block).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.
